# AntraHQ
> Salon & spa management software for India — GST billing, POS, guest CRM, memberships & packages, geofenced staff attendance, inventory, WhatsApp marketing, branch P&L, Local Spotlight (Google visibility) and QR reviews. One platform from a single salon to multi-city chains. Published pricing: ₹499 (Starter) and ₹699 (Growth) per branch per month; Enterprise on request. No booking commission. Manager and staff apps in English + 9 Indian languages.

## Primary
- [Home](https://antrahq.com/): Problems AntraHQ solves for salon owners, by role, with a category comparison
- [Pricing](https://antrahq.com/pricing/): Public ₹ per-branch pricing and plan FAQ
- [Products](https://antrahq.com/products/): Every module
- [Book a demo](https://antrahq.com/demo/): Free 30-minute demo
